# LTS BAGS PRIVATE LIMITED

> Premier B2B Custom Bag Manufacturer in Mumbai, India. Direct factory manufacturing of custom corporate backpacks, executive laptop bags, school bags, travel duffels, eco jute and canvas totes, and promotional merchandise for bulk orders, corporate gifting, and global export.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity Name**: LTS BAGS PRIVATE LIMITED

- **Coordinates**: Latitude 19.0402° N, Longitude 72.8509° E
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified Quality Management System
- **GST / Tax ID**: 27AAGCL1568H1ZC
- **Primary Website**: https://ltsbags.com

- **Business Model**: B2B Wholesale, OEM/ODM Custom Manufacturing, Corporate Gifting Supply, Institutional Supply, Global Export

## Manufacturing Capabilities & Machinery
- **Production Capacity**: 50,000+ bags per month across dedicated assembly lines.
- **Machinery**: Computerized automated bar-tacking machines, Japanese Juki industrial walking-foot lockstitch sewing machines, high-frequency embossing presses, computerized laser fabric cutters, and multi-color screen and rotary printing beds.
- **Factory Floor**: 5,000+ sq. ft. modern facility located in Mumbai's historic industrial manufacturing corridor.
- **Quality Control**: 100% pre-dispatch inspection including tensile seam testing, zipper fatigue cycles, and 20kg load-drop tests.

## Product Categories & Offerings
1. **Backpacks & Daypacks** (/products/backpacks): Executive laptop backpacks, corporate onboarding packs, collegiate daypacks, ergonomic rucksacks.
2. **Laptop & Office Bags** (/products/laptop-office-bags): Ballistic nylon executive briefcases, messenger bags, padded laptop sleeves (13", 14", 15.6", 16").
3. **School & College Bags** (/products/school-college-bags): Heavy-duty institutional school bags, kindergarten theme bags, coaching class bags with custom school crest.
4. **Travel & Duffel Bags** (/products/travel-bags): Heavy travel duffels, rolling trolley duffles, weekend overnight bags, gym sports holdalls.
5. **Sports & Gym Bags** (/products/sports-gym-bags): Water-resistant duffels with ventilated shoe tunnels, drawstring gym sacks, yoga mat carry bags.
6. **Corporate & Promotional Bags** (/products/corporate-promotional-bags): Conference delegate folders, trade show giveaways, exhibition drawstring bags, employee onboarding kits.
7. **Tote & Shopping Bags** (/products/tote-shopping-bags): Heavy 8oz-16oz organic cotton canvas tote bags, supermarket grocery shoppers, foldable shopping bags.
8. **Jute & Eco Bags** (/products/jute-eco-bags): 100% biodegradable laminated golden jute bags, Juco blend bags, wine bags, seminar eco bags.
9. **Sling & Crossbody Bags** (/products/sling-shoulder-bags): Tech pouch slings, chest packs, utility waist pouches, urban crossbody bags.
10. **Lunch & Utility Bags** (/products/lunch-utility-bags): Thermal insulated lunch bags, medical kit bags, tool technician pouches.
11. **Custom & OEM Manufacturing** (/products/custom-manufacturing): Full pattern making, rapid prototyping (3-5 business days), custom tech-pack development.

## Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ) & Turnaround
- **Standard MOQ**: 50 to 100 units depending on category complexity.
- **Sample Turnaround**: 3 to 5 business days for physical pre-production prototype.
- **Bulk Production Lead Time**: 10 to 18 working days post sample sign-off.
- **Pan-India Delivery**: Express road, rail, and air dispatch to Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and tier-2/3 hubs.
- **Export Markets**: Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia), Europe, United Kingdom, USA, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

## Customization Options
- **Branding**: 3D high-density embroidery, silk-screen printing, rubber PVC badges, debossed PU patches, engraved metal zipper pullers, woven labels, care tags.
- **Materials**: 1680D Ballistic Nylon, 1000D Cordura-style fabric, 600D/900D Ripstop Polyester, Organic Cotton Canvas, Biodegradable Laminated Jute, Vegan PU Leatherette, Waterproof TPU.
- **Hardware**: YKK & heavy-duty branded zippers, zinc alloy metal pullers, reinforced nylon webbing, ergonomic breathable air-mesh padding.
